What Do They Keep Asking?

A study-first index of recurring questions and concepts across the 2025, 2026, 2027, and 2028 Microbiology LE1 exam files. The site prioritizes repeat families, how the framing changes, and what every answer choice means rather than simply reproducing the exams chronologically.

Historical keys and original exam rationales are preserved. Each answer choice now has a choice-specific review plus a question-fit explanation. Uploaded exam rationales and project lecture PDFs are the primary source base. When a choice is not separately defined in those files, the source line explicitly labels the limitation or any supplemental standard microbiology context. Visible warnings preserve source conflicts instead of silently correcting them.
